domain_name: FINRA Rule 2210 — Retail Client Advisory Communication

required_criteria.name: Balanced Risk-Reward Presentation
required_criteria.description: Every mention of potential portfolio yield or tax advantage must be paired in the same section with the specific principal, liquidity, or market risks associated with that asset class.

required_criteria.name: Time Horizon & Suitability Anchor
required_criteria.description: The memo must explicitly reference the client's stated investment time horizon, liquidity needs, and risk tolerance provided in the source notes.

required_criteria.name: Standard Performance Disclosure
required_criteria.description: Must include a clear disclosure that past performance does not guarantee future results and that yields fluctuate with market conditions.

prohibited_criteria.name: Promissory or Guaranteed Return Language
prohibited_criteria.description: Must not contain any language guaranteeing returns, predicting specific future performance, or describing a non-insured investment as 'safe,' 'guaranteed,' or 'risk-free.'

prohibited_criteria.name: Unverified Tax or Legal Advice
prohibited_criteria.description: Must not issue definitive tax or legal opinions without qualifying that the client should consult their CPA or tax attorney.
violation_examples: this will eliminate your tax liability

prohibited_criteria.name: Omission of Fee Impact
prohibited_criteria.description: Must not compare investment vehicles without acknowledging management fees, expense ratios, or surrender charges where applicable.
